findings.problem: 新账号onShow在旧账号归档pending结算前展示旧详情
findings.resolution: onShow立即按epoch清旧详情，只等待当前epoch的pending；pending清理核对promise身份，避免旧账号finally清新请求
findings.regression: new account immediately clears old outfit while the old account archive is still pending

findings.problem: 离页归档成功被页面代次守卫丢弃，保留状态使P02及衣橱不再刷新
findings.resolution: 同epoch成功先使wardrobe失效，页面UI仍受代次守卫；同页返回等待本会话pending后重查，跨账号不等待旧请求
regressions: clothing hidden archive success invalidates wardrobe and rereads the same detail
clothing returned before archive settles waits and reloads; account switch never waits on the previous account

findings.problem: 追加分页失败使旧页尚未完成图片因共用generation失效并永久loading
findings.resolution: 分离分页请求与图片代次；清查询/离页才使图片代次失效，保留页下载不受追加失败影响
findings.regression: outfits pending first-page images remain valid when an appended page fails
